nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) balanceOf storing token balances; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public string state variable holding the token name 'SOCGEN_301201'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'SOCGI'.
Public uint8 state variable holding 18 decimals.
Public uint256 totalSupply = 10780817168445100000000000, assigned to msg.sender in the initializer.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance used by approve and transferFrom.
Public function SimpleERC20Token() that names the contract; it sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply, so if compiled under >=0.4.22 it is no longer a constructor and is publicly callable.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that requires balanceOf[msg.sender] >= value, subtracts value from msg.sender and adds it to 'to' without SafeMath.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) that moves balances and decrements allowance[from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and mint recipient.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint256 value): recipient address.
Parameter 'value' of transfer(address to, uint256 value): amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address spender, uint256 value): allowance beneficiary.
Parameter 'value' of approve(address spender, uint256 value): allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): debited address.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): credited address.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): transferred amount.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked subtraction can underflow if the require check is bypassed or state is inconsistent.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; unchecked addition can overflow.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked addition can overflow.
Arithmetic: allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction on allowance.

Access control: SimpleERC20Token() is a public function whose name differs from the contract SOCGEN_301201; under pragma ^0.4.21 compilers >=0.4.22 treat it as a normal public function, allowing anyone to re-mint totalSupply to themselves.

Any msg.sender can invoke the misnamed initializer and receive the supply.

The 'value' parameter only feeds the unchecked arithmetic inside transfer and should be folded into that function.
The 'spender' parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve.
The 'value' parameter is only stored as the allowance in approve and has no separate behavior.
The 'from' parameter only indexes balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter only indexes the credited balance inside transferFrom.
